name: Trunks & Mai
skill:
[Activate: Main][Once per turn] Discard 1 ≪Saiyan≫ or ≪Earthling≫ card from your hand: Play up to 1 green <Mai: Future> card with an energy cost of 1 from your deck, then shuffle your deck.
[Awaken] When your life is at 4 or less or you have 3 or more Earthling Tokens: Draw 1 card, switch up to 1 of your energy to Active Mode, and add cards from your life to your hand until you have 6 life left.

back.name: SS Trunks & Mai, Saviors of Hope
back.skill:
[Permanent] If you have a green ≪Saiyan≫ card in play, all of your Earthling Tokens gain [Barrier].
[Auto] When this card attacks, play up to 1 green <Mai: Future> card with an energy cost of 1 from your deck or Drop, then shuffle your deck if you looked through it. Additionally, if you and your opponent have a total of 10 or more Battle Cards, this card gets +10000 power for the turn.

name: Mai, Earthling Support
skill:
[Auto] If your Leader is a green card with both <Trunks: Future> and <Mai: Future>: When this card is played, play 1 Earthling Token (1000 power, 0 combo cost, and 0 combo power).
[Auto][Limit 1] If you have 4 or more Earthling Tokens: When this card attacks, choose up to 1 of your opponent's Battle Cards with an energy cost of 3 or less and KO it, then this card gets +11000 power for the battle.

name: SSB Son Goku, Humanity's Hope
skill:
[Permanent] For each of your Earthling Tokens, reduce the energy cost of this card in your hand by 1.
[Auto][Limit 1] Switch 1 of your Earthling Tokens to Rest Mode: When this card attacks, draw 1 card, then choose up to 1 of your opponent's Unisons and remove 2 markers from it.

name: SSB Vegeta, Humanity's Hope
skill:
[Permanent] For each of your Earthling Tokens, reduce the energy cost of this card in your hand by 1.
[Auto][Limit 1] Switch 1 of your Earthling Tokens to Rest Mode: When this card attacks, draw 1 card, then choose up to 1 of your opponent's Battle Cards with an energy cost of 5 or less and KO it.

name: SS Trunks, Humanity's Hope
skill:
[Permanent] For each of your Earthling Tokens, reduce the energy cost of this card in your hand by 1.
[Auto][Limit 1] Switch 1 of your Earthling Tokens to Rest Mode: When this card attacks, draw 1 card, then use up to 1 ≪Saiyan≫ or ≪Earthling≫ card―both mono-green and with 5000 combo power―from your Drop in a combo with its skills negated for the turn.

name: Mai, Link of Hope
skill:
[Auto] When this card is played, draw 1 card.
[Activate: Main][Limit 1] If your Leader is a green card with both <Trunks: Future> and <Mai: Future> and you switch this card to Rest Mode: Play 1 Earthling Token (1000 power, 0 combo cost, and 0 combo power).

name: Mai, Protector of the People
skill:
[Auto] When this card is played, look at up to 5 cards from the top of your deck, add up to 1 ≪Saiyan≫ or ≪Earthling≫ card―both green and with an energy cost of 4 or less―to your hand, then shuffle your deck.
[Activate: Main][Limit 1] If your Leader is a green card with both <Trunks: Future> and <Mai: Future> and you switch this card to Rest Mode: Play 1 Earthling Token (1000 power, 0 combo cost, and 0 combo power).

name: Surprise Attack
skill:
[Counter: Attack] Choose up to 1 of your Rest Mode <Vegito> cards and switch it to Active Mode, that card gets +6000 power for the battle, then switch the target of attack to the chosen card.
[Permanent] For each of your Earthling Tokens, reduce the energy cost of this card in your hand by 1.
